DK25.4 is an ICD-10 diagnosis code representing a chronic or unspecified gastric ulcer with hemorrhage ("kronisk eller ikke specificeret mavesår med blødning") [^src1]. In the context of the Danish healthcare system's clinical quality development, this code plays a specific and vital role in tracking patient safety and treatment outcomes. Specifically, it is utilized within the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database to measure the incidence of severe bleeding among patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren|atrieflimren]] [^src1]. 

Because patients with atrial fibrillation are often treated with anticoagulants, they carry a heightened risk of severe bleeding events. To accurately capture these adverse events, the national clinical quality indicators employ a comprehensive range of diagnostic codes. DK25.4 is part of a broader cluster of codes used to identify gastrointestinal bleeding, alongside other gastric and intestinal codes such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] through DK29.8A, and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through DK92.2 [^src1]. This gastrointestinal cluster is evaluated in conjunction with codes for intracranial bleeding (e.g., [[di60|DI60]] to DS066) and urinary or respiratory bleeding to provide a complete picture of bleeding complications [^src1]. 

The use of DK25.4 and its associated codes ensures that the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) can systematically monitor, compare, and improve the clinical management of atrial fibrillation patients across Danish regions [^src2]. By standardizing how bleeding events are recorded, healthcare providers can better balance the thromboembolic benefits of anticoagulation against the risks of severe hemorrhage.

## Claims
- **Claim:** For incidens af alvorlig blødning anvendes en bred vifte af diagnoser, herunder DI60–DS066 for intrakraniel blødning, DK25.0–DK29.8A og DK92.0–DK92.2 for gastrointestinal blødning samt DJ942, DN02, DR04 og DR31 for urinvejs-/lunge blødning [^src1] (di60, di61, di62, ds064, ds065, ds066, dk25-0, dk25-2, dk25-4, dk25-6, dk26-0, dk26-2, dk26-4, dk26-6, dk27-0, dk27-2, dk27-4, dk27-6, dk28-0, dk28-2, dk28-4, dk28-6, dk29-0, dk29-8a, dk92-0, dk92-1, dk92-2, dj942, dn02, dr04, dr31)
